outcome: Composite maternal outcome (postpartum hemorrhage, transfusion, endometritis, sepsis, wound infection, deep venous thrombosis/pulmonary embolism, hysterectomy, respiratory complications, and intensive care unit admission)
cohort: 902 women undergoing cesarean delivery at 23 0/7 to 31 6/7 weeks' gestation
finding: Classic cesarean delivery was associated with higher maternal complication rates between 28 0/7 and 31 6/7 weeks' gestation, but not between 23 0/7 and 27 6/7 weeks' gestation, compared to low transverse cesarean delivery.
